> "[GRAMMAR] Ensure that the secure password reset process enforces the use of multi-factor authentication if it is enabled."

> Verify that a ~~secure~~ forgotten password reset process ~~is implemented that~~ does not bypass any ~~enabled~~ multi-factor authentication mechanisms.

I'm a bit concerned that both these proposals bury the point that it is important to have a secure forgot password process and that the MFA point is an additional to this.

> "[GRAMMAR] Ensure that the secure password reset process enforces the use of multi-factor authentication if it is enabled."

> Verify that a secure forgotten password reset process is implemented that does not bypass any enabled multi-factor authentication mechanisms.

I'm a bit concerned that both these proposals bury the point that it is important to have a secure forgot password process and that the MFA point is an additional to this.

@elarlang @jmanico @ryarmst @randomstuff any further comments on what I wrote above, as a reminder, I still propose:
